entries.api_behavior: NetpbmImage.Resize(newWidth, newHeight) scales image using nearest-neighbor interpolation. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for zero/negative dimensions. Original unchanged; format preserved.

FodsDocument.RemoveSheet(string name) removes named sheet. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Sheet count decreases; remaining sheets preserved.
FodtDocument.GetWordFrequency(int minLength=1) returns case-insensitive word-count IReadOnlyDictionary. Splits on whitespace+punctuation. Filters by minLength. Merges across paragraphs.

NetpbmImage.Tile(tilesX, tilesY) returns new image tiling source tilesX*tilesY times. Output dimensions = Width*tilesX by Height*tilesY. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for zero/negative tile counts.

FodsDocument.CopySheet(sourceName, newName) clones sheet with new name. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent source or duplicate new name. Sheet count increases.
FodtDocument.RemoveParagraph(int index) removes paragraph at zero-based index. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative/out-of-range index. Count decreases; subsequent paragraphs shift.
NetpbmImage.Solarize(byte threshold) inverts pixels > threshold (pixel = MaxValue - pixel). PBM images return clone unchanged. Original unmodified.

FodsDocument.SetCellStyle(sheetName, row, col, styleName) assigns named style to cell. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace/nonexistent sheetName. Throws ArgumentNullException for null styleName. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid row/col.
FodtDocument.SetParagraphText(int index, string text) replaces text at zero-based index. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid index. Other paragraphs unchanged; paragraph count unchanged.

NetpbmImage.ApplyGamma(double gamma) applies gamma correction: pixel = MaxValue*(pixel/MaxValue)^gamma. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for zero/negative gamma. PBM returns clone unchanged. Original unmodified.

FodsDocument.SetCellFormula(sheetName, row, col, formula) assigns formula string to cell. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace sheetName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Throws ArgumentNullException for null formula. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid row/col.

FodtDocument.GetPlainTextRange(startIndex, endIndex) returns paragraphs [start,end) concatenated with newlines. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative startIndex or endIndex > ParagraphCount. Returns empty string when start >= end.
NetpbmImage.FlipDiagonal() transposes image (pixel[r,c] -> pixel[c,r]). Output Width=original Height, Height=original Width. Format preserved, original unmodified.

FodsDocument.SortRows(sheetName, sortColumn, ascending=true) sorts rows by column. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace sheetName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative sortColumn. Single-row is no-op.
FodtDocument.CharCount property returns total character count across all paragraphs (sum of text lengths). Empty doc=0. Empty paragraph contributes 0. Idempotent.
NetpbmImage.Sharpen() applies Laplacian sharpening kernel to PGM/PPM. PBM returns clone unchanged. Border pixels unmodified. Uniform image interior unchanged. Pixels clamped to [0, MaxValue].

FodsDocument.RenameSheet(oldName, newName) renames existing sheet. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace oldName/newName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent oldName or duplicate newName.
FodtDocument.WordCount property splits GetPlainText() on whitespace (RemoveEmptyEntries). Empty/whitespace-only=0. Idempotent. Increases after AppendParagraph with text.

NetpbmImage.Posterize(int levels) quantizes pixels to nearest of (levels) evenly-spaced buckets. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException if levels < 2. PBM returns clone unchanged. Zero/max pixels unchanged.

FodsDocument.GetColumnHeaders() returns first-row headers from first sheet. GetColumnHeaders(sheetName) returns headers from named sheet. Returns empty for empty/no-sheet/empty-row/nonexistent-named-sheet.

FodtDocument.SetParagraphStyle(int index, string styleName) assigns named style. Throws ArgumentNullException for null styleName. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid index. Paragraph text/count unchanged.
NetpbmImage.MedianFilter(int radius) applies median smoothing. radius=0 returns clone. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative radius. Uniform image interior unchanged. Non-destructive.

FodsDocument.DeleteRows(sheetName, startRow, count) removes count rows starting at startRow. count=0 is no-op. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace sheetName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative count or out-of-bounds range.
FodtDocument.GetTextBetweenParagraphs(startIndex, endIndex) returns null for invalid ranges. Returns paragraphs [start,end) joined by newlines for valid ranges.

NetpbmImage.AdjustContrast(double factor) applies contrast: pixel = mid + (pixel-mid)*factor. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative factor. PBM returns clone. factor=1 is identity; factor=0 maps to midpoint.
FodsDocument.MimeType returns office:document/@office:mimetype (spreadsheet MIME). OdfVersion returns office:document/@office:version. Both non-null for CreateNew(). Both are idempotent.
FodtDocument.GetHeadingTexts() returns text of all heading paragraphs in document order. Returns empty list if no headings. Paragraphs excluded.

entries.api_behavior: FlipHorizontal() mirrors the image left-right in place (void). Pixel at (col, row) swaps with pixel at (W-1-col, row). Width/height/format/MaxValue preserved.
SortRows(sheetName, columnIndex, ascending) sorts rows by column index. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. SheetCount unchanged. Ascending sorts A-Z; descending sorts Z-A.
RemoveParagraph(index) removes paragraph at index. Negative/OOB throws. ParagraphCount decreases. Removing first shifts remaining paragraphs down.
InvertColors() transforms each pixel in-place: pixel = MaxValue - pixel. Void return. Width/height/format/MaxValue preserved. Double invert restores original.
AddColumn(sheetName, values) adds a new column with given values. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. GetColumnCount increases. SheetCount unchanged.
InsertParagraph(index, text) inserts a paragraph at the given index. Negative/OOB throws. ParagraphCount increases. Insert at 0 shifts existing paragraphs.
Rotate90() rotates image 90 degrees clockwise in-place (void). For non-square: new Width=oldHeight, new Height=oldWidth. Format/MaxValue preserved. Four rotations restore original.
ExportToCsv(sheetName, filePath) exports sheet data to CSV file. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. SheetCount unchanged. Exported file exists and is non-empty for data sheets.

GetCharacterCount() returns the total number of characters across all paragraphs. Non-negative. Empty doc returns 0+. Grows with content. Idempotent (same result on consecutive calls). ParagraphCount unchanged.
Crop(x, y, width, height) extracts a rectangular region and returns a new image. Negative/zero/OOB args throw. Result dimensions match requested w/h. Format/MaxValue preserved. Original unchanged.
GetRowCount(sheetName) returns the number of rows in a sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. Empty=0+. After AddRow increases. SheetCount unchanged. Idempotent.

GetParagraphStyle(index) returns the style name of the paragraph at index. Negative/OOB throws. Returns non-null non-empty string. After SetParagraphStyle returns that style. ParagraphCount unchanged. Idempotent.
AdjustBrightness(delta) adds delta to every pixel value in-place, clamping to [0, MaxValue]. Void return. Width/height/format/MaxValue preserved. Zero delta = no change.
GetColumnValues(sheetName, colIndex) returns all values in a column. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. Negative colIndex throws. Returns non-null collection. SheetCount unchanged. Idempotent.

GetParagraphLength(index) returns the character count of the paragraph at index. Negative/OOB throws. Non-negative result. Empty=0+. Non-empty positive. Grows with longer text. ParagraphCount unchanged. Idempotent.
GetAverageBrightness() returns the mean pixel value across all pixels as a double. Non-mutating. Result in [0, MaxValue]. All-zero=0.0. All-max=MaxValue. Idempotent.
SetCellFormula(sheetName, row, col, formula) sets a formula for a cell. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. Negative row/col throws. GetCellFormula retrieves it. Set-twice keeps latest.
ClearParagraph(index) erases the text of a paragraph without removing it. Negative/OOB throws. ParagraphCount unchanged. Text empty after clear. Other paragraphs unaffected. Idempotent.
GetMinPixelValue() returns the minimum pixel value across all pixels as an int. Non-mutating. All-zero=0. Result in [0, MaxValue]. Idempotent.
GetSheetIndex(sheetName) returns the 0-based index of a sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. First sheet=0. After AddSheet second=1. SheetCount unchanged. Idempotent.
DuplicateParagraph(index) creates a copy of the paragraph and inserts it after. Negative/OOB throws. ParagraphCount increases by 1. Duplicate text matches original. Original unchanged.
GetMaxPixelValue() returns the maximum pixel value across all pixels as an int. Non-mutating. All-zero=0. After SetPixel returns that value. Result in [0, MaxValue]. Idempotent.

SetCellBackground(sheetName, row, col, colorName) sets the background color of a cell. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. Negative row/col throws. SheetCount unchanged. Set-twice no-exception. Cell value unaffected.

SetParagraphText(index, text) replaces the text of a paragraph. Negative/OOB throws. ParagraphCount unchanged. GetParagraphText returns new text. Others unaffected. Set-empty allowed. Set-twice keeps final.
Threshold(value) binarizes image in-place (void): pixels >= value become MaxValue; pixels < value become 0. Width/height/format/MaxValue preserved. Zero threshold: all become MaxValue.
CopySheet(fromSheetName, newSheetName) copies a sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent source throws. Null newName throws. SheetCount increases by 1. New sheet in GetSheetNames. Original unchanged.

RemoveTable(tableIndex) removes table at index. Negative/OOB throws. TableCount decreases. Remove single → count=0. Other tables shift down. Dogfood: add then remove; two-tables remove-first second becomes index 0.
Blur() applies smoothing filter in-place (void). Width/height/format/MaxValue preserved. All pixels remain in [0, MaxValue] after blur. Idempotent (can call multiple times).
ClearSheet(sheetName) clears all data from a sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. SheetCount unchanged. Sheet still accessible. GetRowCount decreases. Idempotent (call-twice ok).
GetTableRowCount(tableIndex) returns the number of rows in the table at index. Negative/OOB/no-tables throws. Returns row count matching AddTable rows. TableCount unchanged. Idempotent.

GetContrast() returns a double measure of contrast (non-negative). Non-mutating: width/height/format/MaxValue unchanged. Uniform image returns 0.0. Image with distinct min/max returns positive contrast. Idempotent.

RenameSheet(oldName, newName) renames an existing sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent old name throws. Null new name throws. SheetCount unchanged. Old name removed from GetSheetNames; new name present. Data accessible via new name.
GetTableColumnCount(tableIndex) returns the number of columns in the table at index. Negative/OOB/no-tables throws. Returns column count matching AddTable cols. TableCount unchanged. Idempotent.

Clone() returns a new independent NetpbmImage. Width/height/format/MaxValue match original. Pixel values are copied. Modifying the clone does not affect the original and vice versa. Clone of a clone is valid.
DeleteRow(sheetName, rowIndex) removes a row from the sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative/OOB rowIndex throws. GetRowCount decreases by 1. SheetCount unchanged.

GetTableCellText(tableIndex, row, col) returns the text of a cell. Negative/OOB table index, no-tables, negative/OOB row/col throws. Valid cell returns non-null string. After SetTableCellText returns the set text. TableCount unchanged.

Resize(width, height) returns a new NetpbmImage at the specified dimensions. Zero/negative width or height throws. Result width/height match requested. Format and MaxValue preserved. Original dimensions unchanged.

SetCellComment(sheetName, row, col, comment) attaches an annotation to a cell. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative row/col throws. GetCellComment returns the set comment. SheetCount unchanged. Set-twice keeps second comment.

SetTableCellText(tableIndex, row, col, text) sets cell text in a table. Negative/OOB tableIndex, no-tables, negative row/col throws. Text retrievable via GetTableCellText. TableCount unchanged. Set-twice keeps second value.
GetHistogram() returns a non-null array where index i = count of pixels with value i. All entries >= 0. Sum = Width*Height. Non-mutating: dims/format/MaxValue unchanged. Idempotent.
GetColumnCount(sheetName) returns the number of columns in the sheet. Null/whitespace/nonexistent throws. Empty sheet returns 0+. Increases after AddColumn. SheetCount unchanged. Idempotent.
GetWordCount() returns total word count across all paragraphs. Non-negative. Empty doc = 0. Grows with more paragraphs. ParagraphCount unchanged. Idempotent.
GetStandardDeviation() returns double measure of pixel value spread. Non-negative. Uniform image = 0.0. Varied pixels > 0.0. Non-mutating: dims/format/MaxValue unchanged. Idempotent.

SetColumnWidth(sheetName, colIndex, width) sets the display width of a column. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative colIndex throws. SheetCount unchanged. Set-twice no exception. GetColumnWidth returns > 0 after set.

GetParagraphText(index) returns the text of a paragraph. Negative/OOB throws. Returns non-null string matching added text. After SetParagraphText returns new text. ParagraphCount unchanged. Idempotent.
GetMedianPixelValue() returns median of all pixel values as int. Result in [0, MaxValue]. All-zero=0. Uniform image returns that value. Non-mutating. Idempotent.

SetRowHeight(sheetName, rowIndex, height) sets the display height of a row. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative rowIndex throws. SheetCount unchanged. Set-twice no exception. GetRowHeight returns > 0 after set.
GetSectionCount() returns the number of sections in the document. Non-negative. New doc >= 0. Increases after AddSection. ParagraphCount unchanged. Idempotent.

Normalize() rescales pixel values in-place to use the full [0, MaxValue] range (contrast stretching). Void. Width/height/format/MaxValue unchanged. All pixels remain in [0,MaxValue]. Uniform image no-exception. Idempotent.

GetCellValue(sheetName, row, col) returns the string value of a cell. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative row/col throws. After SetCellValue returns the set value. SheetCount unchanged. Idempotent.

FindAndReplaceText(find, replace) replaces all occurrences of find with replace across all paragraphs. Valid args no-exception. No-match no-exception. ParagraphCount unchanged. After replace, new text present and old text gone.
ApplySharpen() applies a sharpening filter in-place (void). Width/height/format/MaxValue preserved. All pixels remain in [0, MaxValue]. Uniform image no-exception. Idempotent.

InsertRow(sheetName, rowIndex, values) inserts a row at the given index. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative rowIndex throws. GetRowCount increases. SheetCount unchanged. Insert at beginning and middle both work.
SetDocumentTitle(title) sets the document metadata title. GetDocumentTitle() returns it. Valid/empty no-exception. Set-twice second wins. ParagraphCount/TableCount unchanged. Idempotent getter.
GetPixelCount() returns int = Width * Height. Always positive for valid image. Non-mutating: dims/format unchanged. Idempotent. 1x1=1, 6x6=36.
ExportToJson(sheetName, filePath) exports a sheet to a JSON file. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Valid export creates file. Data sheet produces non-empty file. SheetCount unchanged.
GetLineCount() returns total text lines. Non-negative. More paragraphs do not decrease count. ParagraphCount unchanged. Idempotent. Single-line paragraph >= 1.
FlipVertical() flips image upside-down in-place (void). Width/height/format/MaxValue unchanged. Pixel at (col, row) moves to (col, H-1-row). Flip twice restores original. All pixels remain valid.

GetCellType(sheetName, row, col) returns the cell type as non-null string. Null/whitespace/nonexistent sheet throws. Negative row/col throws. After SetCellValue returns non-null. SheetCount unchanged. Idempotent.

SaveToFile(filePath) saves the document to disk. Null/whitespace throws. Valid path no-exception. File exists after save. Non-empty content produces non-empty file. ParagraphCount/TableCount unchanged. Save-twice no-exception (overwrite).
